closure_criteria: The minimal augmentation hierarchy from pairing-frame C2 data to pairing-level S3 and atom-level S4 is terminally classified or an exact no-go identifies the irreducible exogenous data.
Gauge choices, section choices, cohomology classes, and genuinely structural typed augmentations are separated without convention-dependent promotion.
No successor is opened merely to add another arbitrary frame, section, or lift; further work requires an independently motivated semantic relation.
research_value: The closed decorated-carrier arithmetic geometry exposes an exact hierarchy of missing transport choices. Classifying the minimal additional typed information needed to pass from C2 pairing-frame data to S3 pairing transport and then S4 atom transport prevents arbitrary gauge or section choices from being mistaken for arithmetic structure.
scope: Starting only from the reviewed decorated-carrier/resonance complex and its accepted C2 pairing-frame classification, determine the minimal necessary and sufficient typed augmentation data for full pairing-state S3 transport and atom-level S4 transport. Treat automorphism obstructions, group extensions, torsors, nonabelian/twisted cocycles and same-reduct/different-augmentation countermodels as standard tools. Do not reinterpret the new data as derived from Seed-6 arithmetic.
success_criteria: Give an exact necessity-and-sufficiency classification for augmenting the marked pairing C2 transport layer to full pairing-state S3 transport.
Give an exact necessity-and-sufficiency classification for lifting pairing-state transport to atom-level S4, including the role of V4-breaking data.
Separate local frame choice, vertex gauge, global cohomology/holonomy class, S3 section choice and atom-frame/lift data into nonconflated typed layers.

Prove lower bounds on required augmentation data using automorphism/fixed-point obstructions or same-reduct/different-augmentation models, and exhibit constructions attaining the bounds when possible.
Separate standard extension/cohomology facts from any project-local interface theorem and freeze a no-go if the old typed data cannot naturally compress the augmentation space.
title: Decorated Carrier Transport Augmentation Minimality
